title: RemoveRequest
description: Which folder to remove, and for a worktree, the branch it must be merged into.

folder.description: A folder this mode made, relative to the project, such as .forge/worktrees/my-slice.

into.description: For a worktree: the branch its own branch must be merged into before both are removed. A commit: a full or short hash, or a branch name. It has no .. and does not start with a dash.
